notes.title: Playtest Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Improved overall performance.
- Added saving and loading of game data, with new "Save" and "Load" menus.
- Added Steam Cloud integration for save files and settings.
- Adjusted lighting to improve the atmosphere.
- Added new "Gameplay" section in the options menu with QoL features.
- Added Gamma adjustment option in the Video settings.
- Changed placement of the Sword.
- Changed enemy placement.
- Changed item placement.
- Fixed enemy AI bugs.
- Increased time to revive for Ghoul.
- Increased Lantern oil drain speed.
- Increased Crossbow damage.
